name: Basic Scan
description: Performs a basic scan to identify embedded file signatures within a binary file.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting binwalk scan on firmware.bin...

DECIMAL    HEX        DESCRIPTION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
0          0x0        Squashfs filesystem, little endian, version 4.0
1024       0x400      LZMA compressed data, properties: 0x5D, dictionary size: 8388608 bytes, uncompressed size: 6868608 bytes
2048       0x800      LZMA compressed data, properties: 0x5D, dictionary size: 8388608 bytes, uncompressed size: 1228800 bytes
2074320    0x1FD750   JPEG image data, JFIF standard 1.01
3145728    0x300000   Zip archive data, at least v2.0 to extract

[1m[32m[SUCCESS][0m Scan completed.

name: Extract All Files
description: Extracts all identified files from the target binary into a new directory.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting binwalk extraction on firmware.bin...

DECIMAL    HEX        DESCRIPTION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
0          0x0        Squashfs filesystem, little endian, version 4.0
1024       0x400      LZMA compressed data, properties: 0x5D
[1m[32m[SUCCESS][0m Extraction succeeded: 'firmware.bin.extracted/_firmware.bin.squashfs'
2074320    0x1FD750   JPEG image data, JFIF standard 1.01
[1m[32m[SUCCESS][0m Extraction succeeded: 'firmware.bin.extracted/1FD750.jpeg'
3145728    0x300000   Zip archive data, at least v2.0 to extract
[1m[32m[SUCCESS][0m Extraction succeeded: 'firmware.bin.extracted/300000.zip'

[1m[34m[INFO][0m Extracted files have been saved to 'firmware.bin.extracted'.

name: Entropy Scan
description: Performs an entropy analysis to identify areas of high randomness, which may indicate compressed or encrypted data.
example_output:
[1m[34m[INFO][0m Starting binwalk entropy analysis on firmware.bin...

DECIMAL    HEX        DESCRIPTION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
0          0x0        Entropy data, high probability of being compressed/encrypted data
[1m[33m[WARNING][0m Significant entropy increase at offset 0x300000
[1m[33m[WARNING][0m Significant entropy decrease at offset 0x420000

[1m[32m[SUCCESS][0m Entropy analysis completed. Run a basic scan for file signatures.
